description: This file defines a 'Root' type and associated methods for safe path resolution within a directory tree on Linux, including operations like open, create, rename, delete, and symlink management, with a focus on security and sandboxing.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: A handle representing the root of a directory tree for secure path operations on Linux.

methods.name: OpenRoot
methods.description: Creates a new Root handle to a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: RootFromFile
methods.description: Creates a Root handle from an existing os.File referencing a directory.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a path within the Root's directory tree, following symlinks.

methods.name: ResolveNoFollow
methods.description: Resolves a path without following the final symlink component.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file at a given path within the Root.

methods.name: OpenFile
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags within the Root.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new file at a path within the Root.

methods.name: Rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory within the Root.

methods.name: RemoveDir
methods.description: Removes an empty directory within the Root.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Removes a file within the Root.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a file or directory within the Root.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Recursively deletes a path and its contents.

methods.name: Mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory within the Root.

methods.name: MkdirAll
methods.description: Creates a directory and any necessary parent directories.

methods.name: Mknod
methods.description: Creates a device inode within the Root.

methods.name: Symlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link within the Root.

methods.name: Hardlink
methods.description: Creates a hard link within the Root.

methods.name: Readlink
methods.description: Returns the target of a symlink within the Root.

methods.name: IntoFile
methods.description: Returns the underlying os.File of the Root.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Root handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the Root handle.
